name: B10-0394/2026 (PPE) – Political prisoners in Cuba, in particular the case of Félix Navarro and his daughter Saylí Navarro
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on political prisoners in Cuba, in particular the case of Félix Navarro and his daughter Saylí Navarro
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and making demands. It calls on Cuba to release Félix Navarro, his daughter Saylí Navarro and all other political prisoners, and to stop ill-treatment in detention. It asks the European Union to suspend its cooperation agreement with Cuba unless the government makes real progress towards democracy, and to impose targeted sanctions on those responsible for repression, starting with Miguel Díaz-Canel.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. These are demands, not decisions.
- **Who it affects:** Cuba's government, political prisoners and their families.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to the EU's foreign policy chief, the Council, the Commission and Cuba's government.
